FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What does Online mean?

Online means the Forks Land bot has recently sent a valid heartbeat to the monitoring system.

How is uptime calculated?

Uptime begins when the bot starts a new heartbeat session and continues while valid heartbeats are received.

Why can Discord members be different?

Discord's public widget only exposes the presence information Discord makes available through the widget.

Where can I join Forks Land?

Use the official invite: dc.gg/fork-lands
